title: Assessing Employability Impact of Training Courses Supported by Government Funds
what_it_is: Assessing Employability Impact of Training Courses Supported by Government Funds

sections.label: TRAQOM survey on SSG-funded programmes
sections.summary: SSG runs the TRAQOM survey on all SSG-funded programmes to collect trainee feedback on training quality and work performance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: SSG runs the Training Quality and Outcomes Measures (TRAQOM) survey on all SSG-funded programmes, to collect trainee feedback on the quality of training and whether the training has enabled them to improve their work performance and take on enhanced job roles.

sections.label: TRAQOM results and outcome studies
sections.summary: TRAQOM results are published on MySkillsFuture and used in funding assessments, with partners monitoring wage and employment outcomes through surveys and studies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The TRAQOM survey results are published on the MySkillsFuture portal to help individuals make informed training choices, and SSG uses these results when assessing training providers for continued funding.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In addition, we work with partners, such as the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) to monitor wage and employment outcomes through programme-specific surveys and studies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Economic studies that have been published include evaluations of the Work-Study Post-Diploma programmes in 2019 and Singapore Workforce Skills Qualification (WSQ) training in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Both showed trainees graduating from these programmes with positive wage outcomes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Regular surveys, such as the Work-Study Programme Outcomes Survey, also collect information on employment outcomes six months after completion of the programme.

sections.label: Poor training provider results
sections.summary: A question asks whether training organisations with consistently poor results were removed from Government financial support eligibility, with SSG having adjusted or ceased training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Based on these survey results – which I assume are provided by a trainer or training organisation – has there been any cases of a training organisation that consistently gets very poor results and, therefore, has been removed from the list of trainers that are eligible for Government financial support?

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: I do not have the data with me, but I believe that SSG has considered past feedback from trainees on training providers where the courses did not meet their expectations and that the training quality was deemed to be not satisfactory, and had either worked with the training providers to adjust training mode of conduct or ceased training for such training providers.
